description: Java class implementing a JSON serializer for API responses in the Fineract project, utilizing Gson and Spring annotations.

classes.name: DefaultToApiJsonSerializer
classes.description: A generic class that serializes Java objects into JSON for API responses, supporting partial responses and settings.

methods.name: serializeResult

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object into JSON, with support for different settings, collections, pages, and single objects.

methods.name: serializeWithSettings
methods.description: Helper method to serialize data with a specified Gson serializer and settings.

methods.name: findAppropriateSerializer
methods.description: Selects the appropriate Gson serializer based on whether a partial response is required.
